Built at 38" in length, with a 17" oversize grip, promoting a one-piece pendulum stroke.

products.title: Evnroll MidLock – Armlock Putter Grip
products.body_html:
#1 Armlock Putter Grip

This comfortable setup allows for an effortless one-piece putting stroke with no moving parts.

By positioning the grip sideways the deep pistol pushes the shaft angle away from the mid-forearm reducing shaft lean, similar to a simple forward press. The new Midlock Grip features the deepest pistol dimension allowed by the USGA.

*Grip has an inner core diameter of .580"

Please Note: This product should be used only as a replacement grip for a Midlock Putter. You may need to use extra layers of grip tape as the Midlock XL is 17″ and will often get down to a portion of the shaft that is a slightly smaller diameter than the grip hole.
